title: The Machine Record: incidents involving commercial physical robots
description: Case metadata of The Machine Record, a public register of incidents involving commercial physical robots (robotaxis, delivery robots, warehouse and industrial machines, surgical systems, humanoids). One row per documented incident, with a permanent case page that carries the timeline from first report to any recall, investigation, lawsuit or settlement, and the archived sources. Refreshed daily from the site's open API. Not a safety rating: fleet sizes are not public.
